actors.name: Rosa
actors.private_context: Rosa needs a 2,000-peso loan until payday and has sent a text to her brother Emilio asking for it. She hopes for a clear yes-or-no answer within 48 hours.

actors.name: Emilio
actors.private_context: Emilio received a text from his sister Rosa asking for a 2,000-peso loan until payday. He has not yet responded. He may consider his own financial situation, relationship with Rosa, and other factors before deciding whether and how to reply.

shared_context: Rosa and Emilio are siblings. Rosa sent a text message to Emilio requesting a 2,000-peso loan until payday. The message was sent before the simulation start time. Emilio has the message and can reply via text. The cutoff for a response is 48 hours from the start time.

starting_events.description: Rosa's text requesting a 2,000-peso loan until payday is already in Emilio's inbox, sent before this time.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Emilio sent a text message to Rosa containing a clear yes or no answer to the loan request before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
